title: Pool-house lounge, dark timber soffit – two recessed in a row
mount: LC recess (no trim), 2 in a row along the boards
source: Real photo: library w-bromic-tungsten-electric-residential (bromic.com, Sydney residence; bank cad/backgrounds/tungsten/bromic-tungsten-electric-residential.jpg). The two Series I recessed heaters, a Tungsten under the beam edge and four heaters in the background pavilion were removed; heaters are the Tungsten Series II CAD (6 kW + LC recess kit STEP), recessed flush at the original positions, turned to run with the boards, at the true ceiling height (camera from EXIF 22 mm and the board vanishing points; scale from the old 1,410 mm heater). Low resolution: 2560 px (below 4K).
